label: Bible Study
prompt: And all that believed were together, and had all things _____;
verse: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
note: The first believers shared everything — Acts says no one among them lacked.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Give us this day our _____ bread.
verse: Give us this day our daily bread.
note: From the Lord's Prayer: ask for today's bread, not a year's supply — like manna, tomorrow's comes tomorrow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a _____, and girded himself.
verse: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
note: The King of kings rose from supper, laid aside his garments, and picked up a servant's towel.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the _____.
verse: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
note: Asa had trusted God against a million-man army — but late in life he trusted doctors, not the LORD.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is _____.
verse: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
note: Psalm 145, titled 'David's Psalm of praise,' calls God's greatness 'unsearchable' — a well with no bottom.
